g0.note: Eligibility is read from authoritative directions, never from the jar or the name (§2.1, §2.2 step 1). The 'rinsed out' conjunct is not carried by the directions, and §2.3 requires the directions text to carry mode, contact time AND rinse. Nothing positively places it on the leave-on side, so this is not a charter exclusion: it is an identity/evidence stop (`insufficient_information`, round-2 triage note), no profile, routed to evidence work (fresh exact-pack directions capture). The wet-hair note cannot rescue it — that note itself requires the directions to 'state a rinse-out'. Inferring the rinse from 'einwirken lassen' would fail toward inclusion on an evidence gap (§1.1).
